<h3>iLand version 2.0 for Windows</h3>
This is the iLand version 2.0 (released 2024-07-17).  </br>
Check out more details on this release on the iLand  blog [here](https://iland-model.org/blogpost60-Release-of-iLand-2-0).

The download package includes the executables and all required libraries. Just unzip and run, no need for installation. Source code available at: https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model/releases/tag/v2.0
A download link for the demo landscape is given at the top of this page!


iLand is a research and software development effort free of charge. The software is GPL-licencsed, which means you can use, modify and redistribute your modifications. See our [terms and conditions](terms-and-conditions.qmd) for more details.

<h3>iLand version 1.0 for Windows</h3>
This is the iLand version 1.0 (released 2016-11-16), i.e. the model version that is "feature complete" in the sense that it includes all major processes that were originally planned.
Compared to the last major public release, this version includes the agent based forest mangement engine and the bark beetle disturbance module. </br>
Check out more details on this release on the iLand  blog [here](https://iland-model.org/blogpost58-iLand-1-0-released) and [here](https://iland-model.org/blogpost57-iLand-1-0-release-in-numbers).

The download package includes:
<ul>
<li>The executable and all required libraries. Just unzip and run, no need for installation</li>
<li>The full C++ source code of iLand (sourcecode.zip).</li>
<li>An example landscape including a species parameter set for Europe</li>
</ul>
</div></div>

<h3>iLand version 0.8 for Windows</h3>
This is the iLand version 0.8 (released 2014-08-01), i.e. the model version used for the study "Seidl R, Rammer W, Spies TA, 2014: Disturbance lagacies increase the resilience of forest ecosystem structure, composition, and functioning, , Ecol. Appl., [dx.doi.org/10.1890/14-0255.1](http://dx.doi.org/10.1890/14-0255.1)". This iLand version includes the fire disturbance module and many other improvements and fixes.
More details on the [iLand news blog](https://iland-model.org/tiki-view_blog.php?blogId=2) and on the iLand [tech blog](https://iland-model.org/tiki-view_blog.php?blogId=1).
The download package includes:
<ul>
<li>The executable and all required libraries. Just unzip and run, no need for installation</li>
<li>The full C++ source code of iLand (src.zip).</li>
</ul>
</div></div>

<h3>iLand version 0.7 for Windows</h3>
This is the iLand version 0.7 (released 2013-10-14), i.e. the model version used for the study "Seidl R, Rammer W, Blennow K, 2013: Simulating wind disturbance impacts on forest landscapes: Tree-level heterogeneity matters. Environ. Model. Software,  [doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2013.09.018](http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2013.09.018)". This version includes the first iLand disturbance module (wind). More details on the [iLand news blog](https://iland-model.org/tiki-view_blog.php?blogId=2) and on the iLand [tech blog](https://iland-model.org/tiki-view_blog.php?blogId=1).
The download package includes:
<ul>
<li>The executable and all required libraries. Just unzip and run, no need for installation</li>
<li>The full C++ source code of iLand (src.zip).</li>
</ul>
</div></div>

<h3>iLand 0.3 for Windows</h3>
iLand version 0.3 (released 2012-03-21), i.e. the model version applied for the simulations presented in [Seidl et al. (2012)](http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2012.02.015). More infos about the release can be found at the [iLand blog](http://iland-model.org/blogpost35). The download package includes:
<ul>
<li>The executable and all required libraries. Just unzip and run, no need for installation</li>
<li>Example application including exemplarily stand and climate data for a simulation experiment in Oregon, USA</li>
<li>The full C++ source code of iLand (src.zip).</li>
</ul>
